_about: RAG sources per variant (keys must match variants.py). Each variant gets its own Chroma collection; 'sources' are web pages or PDF URLs crawled into it. 'note' is documentation only and is ignored by the loader. Edited on the server: re-read by the nightly refresh (1 AM) or on restart. See README 'RAG sources'.
